rootCauseCorrection.priorDefect: The signed stage and backup leaf paths included a lease-id intermediate directory, but the executor neither signed nor created that directory. The former fixture recursively pre-created both directories and masked the production failure.
rootCauseCorrection.stageContainer: The new signed lease must bind path, uid, gid and mode for the exact stage parent slash lease id. It must be absent and non-symlink before writes, created no-replace, and captured by device and inode identity before the stage leaf is created.
rootCauseCorrection.backupContainer: The new signed lease must bind path, uid, gid and mode for the exact backup parent slash lease id. It must be absent and non-symlink before writes, created no-replace, and captured by device and inode identity before the backup leaf is created.
rootCauseCorrection.cleanup: Every failure and automatic rollback removes only an exact identity and inventory matched leaf, then only its exact empty identity matched container. Foreign, non-empty, symlinked or substituted objects are preserved and cause terminal fail-closed status.
rootCauseCorrection.success: A successful deployment removes the exact empty stage leaf and stage container before the switch, retains the exact backup leaf and backup container as rollback material, and emits both full tuples, identity tuples and inventory hashes.
rootCauseCorrection.manualRollback: The separately signed manual rollback lease must consume the emitted backupContainer and backup receipts, prove stage and stageContainer remain absent, restore the old runtime, remove only the exact backup leaf, and remove only the exact empty backup container.

requestedWhollyNewLease.terminalSuccess: Retain only the signed backup leaf and backup container, release container, release, and exact control objects; current and service must match the candidate and all candidate gates.
